analysis: Target-excluded training achieved validation macro HR@10 of 0.5613, up from 0.5537 (+0.0076). Electronics improved from 0.33 to 0.36. Current HR@10 values are Movies_and_TV 0.59, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.61, Electronics 0.36, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.685. These results support retaining the correction, although they do not establish that self-similarity caused the earlier weakness. Electronics remains the weakest category. No test metrics were accessed or reported.
code_summary: Uses separate 64-dimensional LightGCN models for all four datasets, averaging initial embeddings with two graph propagation layers. Training uses BPR with Adam, embedding regularization, and gradient clipping. User representations combine graph embeddings with a 0.5-weighted history profile using a 10-interaction half-life. For each sampled positive, training removes its aggregated weight across all occurrences and renormalizes the remaining profile; histories containing only that positive yield a zero profile. Deterministic checks cover values, gradients, repeated positives, and singleton histories while preserving RNG state. Exported inference architecture and dataset routing remain unchanged, using complete supplied histories. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10, then NDCG@10.
